select date_format(r.sale_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as dateStr, r.dept_id as deptId, d.dept_name as deptName, ifnull(sum(r.sale_amount), 0) as totalSales from fin_sale_record r left join sys_dept d on r.dept_id = d.dept_id
group by date_format(r.sale_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), r.dept_id, d.dept_name order by dateStr, r.dept_id

select r.dept_id as deptId, d.dept_name as deptName, ifnull(sum(r.sale_amount), 0) as totalSales, count(1) as orderCount, ifnull(sum(r.total_quantity), 0) as totalQuantity from fin_sale_record r left join sys_dept d on r.dept_id = d.dept_id
group by r.dept_id, d.dept_name order by totalSales desc

select r.product_id as productId, r.product_name as productName, ifnull(sum(r.sale_amount), 0) as totalSales, ifnull(sum(r.total_quantity), 0) as totalQuantity, r.dept_id as deptId, d.dept_name as deptName from fin_sale_record r left join sys_dept d on r.dept_id = d.dept_id
group by r.product_id, r.product_name, r.dept_id, d.dept_name order by totalSales desc limit 20
